messages:
devesh: Quick design review — scorecard empty state + legend ordering. Uploaded current mock to Fig (link). Main asks: 1) legend hierarchy (what drives colors vs badges), 2) empty state CTA wording + placement, 3) bulk-approve affordance & keyboard shortcut. Trying to keep compact mode but avoid confusion :eyes: lia: Skimmed mock. Legend feels visually noisy when compact. The color bars are stronger than the textual badges; recommend swapping visual weight so badges (Pass/Fail/Flaky) read first, color as secondary. Also empty state feels like a 404 — needs short explainer + 1 primary CTA + link to docs. owen: Agreed with Lia. For compact view idea: badges left, then short label, then thin color strip as accent. That keeps scan order for screen readers too (badge text first). tara: Accessibility nits: keyboard focus order currently goes: legend color > legend text > controls. We need logical DOM order: badge text -> legend control -> color. Also add aria-live to the approval confirmation toast. Example aria for approve button:```html ``` And toast:```html
3 examples approved
``` devesh: Good call. For copy, Owen suggested "Approve selected" vs me thinking "Approve batch". Which is clearer? owen: "Approve selected" maps to UI patterns we already use elsewhere. "Approve batch" feels more technical. Go with "Approve selected" and keyboard shortcut `Ctrl+Enter` (mac: ⌘+Enter) as an optional. Add tiny tooltip on hover with shortcut text. lia: For empty state copy proposal: short header "No evaluations yet" then body: "Create a prompt set or run a sample to see scorecards and diffs." Primary CTA: "Create prompt set". Secondary link: "See example runs". Keep action prominent; avoid burying it in the top-right. tara: Also: color contrast on the failure red strip falls below 4.5:1 on some monitors. Can we pick a deeper red or use a patterned hatch for the strip? Pattern helps for colorblind users. devesh: Pattern + stronger red sounds good. We should also add an option in settings to toggle patterned legend for high-contrast mode. ai-evals-bot: New eval run processed: 1755067890. Summary: 42 examples, 6 failures, 3 flaky. Link: (results). :robot_face: lia: Quick UX ask: when ai-evals-bot posts run summary, can we make its message collapsible in the scorecard header (so users don't scroll past) and include a compact summary line? e.g., "42 examples • 6 failures • 3 flaky — view details". own: For regression diffs, we should give an inline mini preview on hover of example rows (snapshot of before/after). But need to ensure it's keyboard accessible: show preview with focus, escape to close. Also add aria-describedby pointing to a short caption for the diff. tara: Small copy nits: change CTA "View failing examples" -> "View failures" (shorter, consistent with other places). Also ensure pluralization works for single failure: "1 failure". devesh: Action items: 1) Lia/Owen — update mock with badge-first legend + color accent + pattern option; 2) Tara — add aria spec for approve toast and diff preview; 3) Me — update copy proposals (empty state + CTAs) and sync with docs. Can we aim for a follow-up design pass by EOD Fri? :calendar: lia: Can do. I'll push a revised mock and add contrast variants. own: I'll prototype hover/keyboard preview behavior in the sandbox. tara: I'll drop a small accessibility checklist into the thread (focus order, aria-live, aria-describedby, color patterns). devesh: Thanks all. If anyone sees obvious regressions in compact mode after these changes flag them here. :thumbsup:
